title: Send and Transfer Review (layout and navigation only)
note: UI evidence, kept outside evidence/*/cases/. Completes no P3 case: P3-W02 (personal send), P3-02 and S8.3 (managed OwnerTransfer), WQ04, WQ05 and WQ07 stay open.

planReference: docs/plans/03 - Android Owner Wallet.md v7.1, S8.1 Send screen group, S8.2 (personal transfer preview fields; token amount never added to ETH), S8.3 (owner transfer pauses the managed wallet and increments authorityEpoch)
implemented: Send: From selector separates Personal account and Agent wallet; the Agent wallet choice shows a conditional owner-transfer warning ('A successful owner transfer pauses agents and invalidates their existing permissions. Choosing or reviewing it does not stop anything yet.'); account and spendable shown as unavailable

Draft store (state/sendDraft.ts): in-memory only, keyed by account and chain; keeps source, asset, recipient and amount through font-size remounts and Send -> Review -> Edit; cleared by Discard draft, by leaving Send (back button, Android back, gesture), by account/network switch (switchContext) and by lock/logout/wallet removal (clearAllDrafts). Holds only those four public form fields
Mobile test harness: apps/mobile 'test': 'tsx --test test/*.test.ts' using the workspace's pinned tsx and Node's test runner; tests load pure state modules only, no React Native screens
Send: asset selector ETH/DemoUSD; To and Amount text fields work locally; Scan, Contacts and Max disabled with reasons; captions state that addresses and amounts are not checked
Send: network fee 'Quote unavailable' and fee payer by source; Review enabled only when both fields have text

Transfer Review: values shown exactly as typed and tagged 'Amount not checked' / 'Address not checked'; From, account, network; fee, payer and total unavailable; token amount and ETH fee stated as never added together
Transfer Review: reads the draft from the store (no transfer values in navigation params); 'Confirm and send' disabled with the reason; Edit returns to the same draft; no success screen exists
Segmented control moved to components/Segmented.tsx and shared by Receive and Send; PrimaryButton gains a disabled state
fabricated: none: no balance, fee, validation result, signature or successful transfer
sampleInput: Typed for the screenshots only: recipient 'sample-recipient-not-checked', amount '0.01'. Neither is stored or sent.
dependencies: No new packages. apps/mobile/package.json gains 'test' (tsx --test test/*.test.ts) and 'check' (tsc --noEmit && tsx --test test/*.test.ts), using the root's pinned tsx 4.20.6 as packages/schema does. app.json, lockfile, root configuration and native code unchanged
limitations: Account/network switch and lock/logout/wallet-removal clearing (switchContext, clearAllDrafts) are implemented and unit-tested but not yet called: accounts, app lock and sessions do not exist. They must be wired when P3-W01 and P3-W03 land.

The 10 store tests passed but were written with the store and not run failing first. Future functional work follows the plan's red/green process (failing assertion recorded before the implementation).
Mobile tests are not yet connected to the root 'make check-mobile', which still runs scripts/not-ready.mjs. See person1Request.

person1Request.reason: Run the mobile unit tests from the root without reporting mobile acceptance as passing: native, instrumentation and installed-app suites do not exist yet (AGENTS.md: root acceptance commands must not report success for absent implementations).
person1Request.patch:
Makefile: replace
  check-platform check-mobile check-agents:
  	node scripts/not-ready.mjs $@
with
  check-platform check-agents:
  	node scripts/not-ready.mjs $@
  check-mobile:
  	node scripts/check-suite.mjs node @mandate/mobile
  	node scripts/not-ready.mjs check-mobile-native
(keep check-mobile in .PHONY)
person1Request.effect: make check-mobile runs apps/mobile 'check' (typecheck + Node tests) and fails on any test failure or on zero tests, then still exits nonzero with 'check-mobile-native: ... not available' until the native suites are wired. The second line is removed only when the :owner-wallet Gradle and Maestro suites exist.
person1Request.verified: apps/mobile 'check' passes directly (10/10). scripts/check-suite.mjs itself cannot spawn ./scripts/pnpm.sh on Windows (EFTYPE, a Windows limitation of the script); verified on Linux (WSL) instead, see checks.
